useCase: Zero-shot and few-shot detección of generado por IA content a través de multiple generator types
mechanism: Encodes the input image using CLIP's ViT-L/14 vision encoder to produce a 768-dimensional característica vector. A trained linear probe classifier then determines whether the semantic características match patrones typical of generado por IA content. Leverages CLIP's understanding of visual-semantic relationships.
accuracy: Alta - 85-93% a través de diverse AI generators
name: Detección de IA basada en CLIP
source: Radford et al. (2021) - Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision, ICML
parameters: Backbone: ViT-L/14, Feature dim: 768, Classifier: linear probe, Input size: 224x224, Preprocessing: center crop + normalize
description: Leverages OpenAI CLIP vision-modelo de lenguaje para detectar semantic inconsistencias entre image content and expected real-world properties. Utiliza contrasteive learning for zero-shot detección.

references.title: Radford, A. et al. (2021). Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision. ICML.
Ojha, U. et al. (2023). Towards Universal Fake Image Detectors that Generalize Across Generative Models. CVPR.

strengths:
• Excellent generalization a través de AI generators
• Captures high-level semantic inconsistencias
• Pre-trained on massive dataset (400M image-text pairs)
• Works well without fine-tuning
limitations:
• Requires significant computational resources
• May not catch low-level pixel artefactos
• Performance varies with image resolución
• Large model size (~900MB)
